title: WebGPU Demo Honesty Audit: Make the Write Up Match the Repo

cover.alt: Blue triangular prism and its matching reflection on a forensic inspection bench

figures.title: Turn each feature claim into a decision
figures.summary: Start with what the repository demonstrates.

items.label: Inspect the code
items.detail: Make a short list of implemented behavior.

items.label: Extract the claim
items.detail: Identify the sentence that implies a feature or result.

items.label: Attach proof
items.detail: Link the exact file, function, demo or measurement artifact.

items.label: Keep or narrow
items.detail: Keep supported wording; rewrite partial claims to match the evidence.

items.label: Cut or label future
items.detail: Remove unsupported claims or clearly separate planned work.

figures.caption: The audit workflow from the article, rather than a claim that every feature exists in the demo.

figures.title: Verify the write-up like a new reader
figures.summary: The final pass tests the evidence trail, not the polish of the prose.

items.label: Feature trace
items.detail: Every feature statement maps to inspectable implementation.

items.label: Working link
items.detail: Each proof URL opens the intended destination.

items.label: Measured result
items.detail: A performance number has a repeatable report or log.

items.label: Present versus future
items.detail: Implemented behavior and next experiments are clearly separated.
